up: Find all compounds associated with the document having ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1126835'. Join `docs` (filtered by `chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1126835'`) to `compound_records` on `doc_id`. Join `molecule_dictionary` on `molregno` to retrieve `chembl_id`, `pref_name` (alias as `name`), `max_phase`, and `structure_type` (alias as `type`). Join `compound_structures` on `molregno` to retrieve `canonical_smiles`. Return exactly these columns: `chembl_id`, `name`, `max_phase`, `type`, `canonical_smiles`. Order the results by `chembl_id` ascending. Use SELECT DISTINCT to ensure each compound is listed only once.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name AS name, md.max_phase, md.structure_type AS type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1126835' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC
